title: Gideon and the Vow
author: Mirabel Crane
blurb: Freya Villalobos, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
